hooks.name: SAM Validate on saving the template
hooks.description: Runs sam validate --lint in the saved template directory. Reads filePath from the stdin JSON.

action.command: FILE=$(python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('filePath',''))" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$FILE" ]; then cd "$(dirname "$FILE")" && sam validate --lint; fi
